title: Compute exact tipsy cop-and-robber survival probabilities

source.citation: Markov models for the tipsy cop and robber game on graphs, arXiv:2102.13532

translation.notes: The source's path-distance model is replayed with its n=10, M=7, r=0.30 and t=0.40 parameters, represented as exact rationals. Matrix powers give survival and solving (I-T)e=1 gives expected duration.
